title: Algerian Vegetable Tagine
description: A flavorful and aromatic vegetarian tagine dish, made with a variety of vegetables and spices, perfect for a hearty dinner.

ingredients.name: Lamb
ingredients.notes: Used for flavor and texture, but in small quantity to make it vegetarian

ingredients.name: Algerian spices
ingredients.notes: Blend of cumin, coriander, and cinnamon

ingredients.name: Tomatoes
ingredients.notes: Diced and added for flavor and moisture

instructions: Heat oil in the bottom of a large clay or ceramic tagine or Dutch oven over medium heat.
Add the chopped onions and cook until they are caramelized, stirring occasionally.
Add the chopped carrots and zucchini, and cook for an additional 5 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Add the diced potatoes, red bell pepper, and Algerian spices. Cook for 5 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Add the diced tomatoes, salt, and black pepper. Stir to combine.
Reduce heat to low and simmer for 20-25 minutes or until the vegetables are tender.
Taste and adjust seasoning as needed.
Serve hot, garnished with fresh herbs, if desired.
